# Knit

> Offline desktop workbench (Rust Workspace + Tauri v2 + React/TypeScript) for converting images and documents into PDF, merging/splitting PDFs, packing encrypted archives or manga volumes, and batch-renaming files. Current workspace version: 0.2.1.

## image2pdf Integration & API Surfaces

- [image2pdf Agent Guide](docs/tools/image2pdf/image2pdf-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-pdf` snippets, SVG/GIF RichMedia support, UI-to-API mapping, config/bounds tables, and exact error string fixes
- [image2pdf Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/image2pdf.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `PageDraft`, `BookmarkNode`, `Image2PdfConfig`, `PdfBuildResult`, and annotated `x-ipc-operations`
- [image2pdf Architecture & Diagrams](docs/tools/image2pdf/image2pdf-architecture.md): three-layer architecture, streaming writer, dual-semaphore preview pipeline, domain class diagram, and validated Mermaid diagrams
- [image2pdf Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/image2pdf/image2pdf-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases (Domain EP/BVA, Decision Tables, State Transitions, Use Cases, Fault Attack) and Requirements Traceability Matrix

## pdf-ops (PDF Merge & Split) Integration & API Surfaces

- [pdf-ops Agent Guide](docs/tools/pdf-ops/pdf-ops-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-pdf::ops` snippets, merge/split rules, and exact error strings
- [pdf-ops Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/pdf-ops.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `PdfInfo`, `PageSelection`, `PdfMergeConfig`, `PdfSplitRule` (5 variants), and `x-ipc-operations`
- [pdf-ops Architecture & Diagrams](docs/tools/pdf-ops/pdf-ops-architecture.md): mmap `inspect_pdf` filtering, 4-entry `HAYRO_PDF_CACHE`, 1-file-at-a-time streaming `merge_pdfs`, `per_page`/`per_file` merge modes, and virtualized grid UI
- [pdf-ops Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/pdf-ops/pdf-ops-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases and RTM for PDF Merge & Split

## docs2pdf (Document -> PDF) Integration & API Surfaces

- [docs2pdf Agent Guide](docs/tools/docs2pdf/docs2pdf-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-docs` snippets for Markdown, code, HTML/CDP slide-step, EPUB, and LibreOffice DOCX/PPTX
- [docs2pdf Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/docs2pdf.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `DocInputKind`, `DocConvertOptions`, `HtmlRenderMode`, `HtmlStepTrigger`, `EngineStatus`, and `x-ipc-operations`
- [docs2pdf Architecture & Diagrams](docs/tools/docs2pdf/docs2pdf-architecture.md): three-tier conversion engines (Typst, Chromium CDP WebSocket, isolated `soffice`), cache eviction (`ComemoEvictGuard`, `LAST_PARSED_EPUB`, `LAST_CONVERTED_OFFICE`), and multi-language CodeMirror linter
- [docs2pdf Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/docs2pdf/docs2pdf-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases and RTM for Document -> PDF

## archive (Archive Packager) Integration & API Surfaces

- [archive Agent Guide](docs/tools/archive/archive-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-archive` snippets for ZIP (AES-256 / ZipCrypto), TAR, TAR.GZ, and TAR.ZST
- [archive Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/archive.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `ArchiveFormat`, `CompressionLevel`, `ZipEncryption`, `ArchiveOptions`, `ArchiveEntrySpec`, and `x-ipc-operations`
- [archive Architecture & Diagram](docs/tools/archive/archive-architecture.md): streaming 64 KiB I/O, `ArchiveTreeEditor` customization, non-blocking output size estimation, ZIP64 support, and atomic `.knit_tmp` writes
- [archive Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/archive/archive-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases and RTM for Archive Packager

## manga-pack (Manga Packager) Integration & API Surfaces

- [manga-pack Agent Guide](docs/tools/manga-pack/manga-pack-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-manga` snippets for scanning Volume/Arc/Chapter hierarchies and packing `.zip`/`.cbz`
- [manga-pack Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/manga-pack.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `MangaScanMode`, `NodeRef`, `Story`, `StoryInfo`, `MangaPackOptions`, and `x-ipc-operations`
- [manga-pack Architecture & Diagram](docs/tools/manga-pack/manga-pack-architecture.md): `Auto` single/library heuristic, NFC normalization, path-traversal-safe cover resolution, whole-story `max_gb` splitting, and RFC 4180 `stories.csv`
- [manga-pack Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/manga-pack/manga-pack-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases and RTM for Manga Packager

## renamer (Batch Renamer) Integration & API Surfaces

- [renamer Agent Guide](docs/tools/renamer/renamer-agent-guide.md): runnable TypeScript Tauri IPC and pure-Rust `knit-renamer` snippets for `ScanFilter`, `PrenameEngine` (`s///`, `y///`), 10 `FixedPresets`, `UserPreset`, and undo rollback
- [renamer Machine-Readable Schema](docs/specs/renamer.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for `ScanFilter`, `RenameRule`, `RenamePlan`, `UserPreset`, `UndoManifest`, and `x-ipc-operations`
- [renamer Architecture & Diagram](docs/tools/renamer/renamer-architecture.md): two-layer filtering, `CachedRenamerScan`, case-insensitive collision detection, Bottom-Up execution, Windows case-only safety, and atomic `UndoManifest`
- [renamer Functional Test Suite](docs/tools/renamer/renamer-functional-tests.md): ISTQB functional test cases and RTM for Batch Renamer
